name: Forever Leveling BiS: Daylight theme
author: github:ubermuda
description: Adds a "Daylight" entry to Forever Leveling BiS's Settings > Display > Theme: the Modern layout in DaylightUI's look (its window background and tint, your DaylightUI accent, its window frame, its window font, sizes, outline and shadow). Without DaylightUI loaded it falls back to plain Modern. Uses only DaylightUI's public API.

operations.content:
local addonName, ns = ...

-- LOCAL ADDITION, not part of Forever Leveling BiS (an addon update removes
-- it, and the .toc line that loads it). A Daylight theme, in DaylightUI's look:
--
--   * the palette: DaylightUI's warm near-black window (its window tint
--     setting included), surfaces stepped up from it, its black outline, its
--     tan labels; the window and panel titles in the accent
--   * the accent: DaylightUI's (its accent setting, class or gradient
--     included), read live. FLBiS's own "Class color" accent setting still
--     wins when picked; "Gold" means DaylightUI's accent here.
--   * the windows, side panels and popups wear DaylightUI's own shell
--     (DaylightUI.API.Skin: its shadow, rounded border, warm band and
--     background at its window opacity), FLBiS's flat backdrop cleared under it
--   * the font already follows DaylightUI (FLBiS's Settings > Font "UI font")
--
-- Its own entry in Settings > Display > Theme, "Daylight" (after Modern,
-- Classic and the skins). It takes a reload, as every theme switch does.
-- Laid out as the Modern theme (FLBiS registers it as a skin so the list
-- and the saved setting know it, but it answers T.Classic() false and has no
-- skin art: T.Skin() nil), so Modern, Classic and the skins are untouched.
-- Without DaylightUI loaded it is plain Modern. Uses DaylightUI's public API only.

local T, W = ns.Theme, ns.Widgets
if not (T and W and T.RegisterSkin) then return end

-- (Patch Keeper's live check: this file loaded and found what it builds on)
PatchKeeper_Live = PatchKeeper_Live or {}
PatchKeeper_Live["flbis-daylight"] = true

local OWNER = "Forever Leveling BiS (Daylight look)"
local KEY = "daylight"

T.RegisterSkin(KEY, { name = "Daylight", icon = "Interface\\AddOns\\DaylightUI\\Media\\logo-64.png" })

-- The Modern layout for it: not Classic, and no skin art. (Every caller goes
-- through T, and T.SkinPart / T.Emblem / T.Accent ask T.Skin.)
local baseClassic, baseSkin = T.Classic, T.Skin
function T.Classic()
    if T.Theme() == KEY then return false end
    return baseClassic()
end
function T.Skin()
    if T.Theme() == KEY then return nil end
    return baseSkin()
end

-- DaylightUI's API (a major version we know) and its core table, or nil.
local function DUI()
    local D = rawget(_G, "DaylightUI")
    local api = type(D) == "table" and D.API
    if type(api) == "table" and api.major == 1 and type(api.Skin) == "function" then return api, D end
    return nil
end

local active = false

local function set(t, r, g, b)
    t[1], t[2], t[3] = r, g, b
end

local function clamp(x)
    if x < 0 then return 0 elseif x > 1 then return 1 end
    return x
end

-- Fills FLBiS's palette tables in place (every widget reads them when it is
-- made, and the tracked painters on each T.Apply).
local function Paint()
    local api, D = DUI()
    if not api then return end
    local Style = type(D.Style) == "table" and D.Style or nil

    -- The window: DaylightUI's background, as its window tint setting makes it.
    local bg
    if Style and type(Style.BackColor) == "function" then
        local ok, c = pcall(Style.BackColor)
        if ok and type(c) == "table" and type(c[1]) == "number" then bg = c end
    end
    bg = bg or { 0.078, 0.078, 0.090 } -- #141417, its default
    local r, g, b = bg[1], bg[2], bg[3]
    -- Each surface a step lighter than the one under it, a touch cool as
    -- DaylightUI's #141417 / #1a1a1e / #25252b are.
    local function lift(k) return clamp(r + k), clamp(g + k), clamp(b + k * 1.12) end

    set(T.WINDOW, r, g, b)
    set(T.BOX, lift(0.024))       -- ~#1a1a1e
    set(T.SURFACE, lift(0.067))   -- ~#25252b
    set(T.FIELD, lift(0.067))
    set(T.RAISED, lift(0.11))     -- the picked choice on a track
    set(T.TRACK, clamp(r - 0.02), clamp(g - 0.02), clamp(b - 0.02)) -- ~#101013, sunk
    set(T.BORDER, 0.024, 0.024, 0.027) -- its outline, #060607
    set(T.THUMB, 0.30, 0.285, 0.255)   -- warm, as its scroll bars
    T.CARD[1], T.CARD[2], T.CARD[3] = 1, 0.97, 0.92 -- (alpha kept: a warm light over the window)

    local okInk, ink = pcall(api.Colors)
    if okInk and type(ink) == "table" and type(ink.LABEL) == "table" then
        set(T.DIM, ink.LABEL[1], ink.LABEL[2], ink.LABEL[3]) -- tan: labels, tabs not picked
    end
    local okAcc, ar, ag, ab = pcall(api.Accent)
    if okAcc and type(ar) == "number" then set(T.TITLE, ar, ag, ab) end -- titles in the accent, as its windows' names
end

-- The accent: DaylightUI's, live, unless FLBiS's "Class color" is picked.
local baseAccent = T.Accent
function T.Accent(alpha)
    if active and T.Get("accent") ~= "class" then
        local api = DUI()
        if api then
            local ok, r, g, b = pcall(api.Accent)
            if ok and type(r) == "number" then return r, g, b, alpha or 1 end
        end
    end
    return baseAccent(alpha)
end

-- The text, as DaylightUI sets its own windows' (Style.Text / Style.ApplyFont):
-- its window font, its size scale (small 12, body 13, heading 15) times its
-- Font size setting, its outline setting and its soft drop shadow. FLBiS's
-- own window font copies (Theme.lua: ForeverLevelingBiSFont*) take it, after
-- FLBiS's font pass on every T.Apply. FLBiS's Text size setting moves it a
-- point at a time from there ("Small", FLBiS's default, is DaylightUI's sizes);
-- FLBiS's Font setting "Blizzard font" leaves FLBiS's text alone.
local ROLE = {
    ForeverLevelingBiSFontNormal = "body",
    ForeverLevelingBiSFontNormalLarge = "head",
    ForeverLevelingBiSFontNormalSmall = "small",
    ForeverLevelingBiSFontHighlightSmall = "small",
    ForeverLevelingBiSFontDisableSmall = "small",
}
local SIZE = { small = 12, body = 13, head = 15 } -- (DaylightUI's Style.SIZE, if it can't be read)
local NON_LATIN = { koKR = true, zhCN = true, zhTW = true } -- (its fonts lack the letters: FLBiS's own handling stays)

local function DressFonts()
    if not active or T.Get("font") == "game" or NON_LATIN[GetLocale()] then return end
    local api, D = DUI()
    local Style = api and type(D.Style) == "table" and D.Style
    if not Style then return end
    local okG, g = pcall(function() return D.DB.General() end)
    g = okG and type(g) == "table" and g or {}
    -- its window font: its Window font pick, else ("general") its font
    local key = g.windowFont
    if type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" or key == "general" then key = g.font end
    local okF, file = pcall(api.FontFile, key)
    if not (okF and type(file) == "string") then return end
    local scale = type(g.fontScale) == "number" and g.fontScale or 1
    local okO, flags = pcall(Style.Outline)
    flags = okO and type(flags) == "string" and flags or ""
    local sh = type(Style.TEXT_SHADOW) == "table" and Style.TEXT_SHADOW or { 1, -1, 0.6 }
    local shadow = g.textShadow == false and 0 or sh[3]
    local sizes = type(Style.SIZE) == "table" and Style.SIZE or SIZE
    local add = (tonumber(T.Get("textSize")) or 0) - (tonumber(T.Default("textSize")) or 0)
    for name, role in pairs(ROLE) do
        local font = _G[name]
        if font and font.SetFont then
            local size = ((sizes[role] or SIZE[role]) + add) * scale
            font:SetFont(file, size, flags)
            font:SetShadowOffset(sh[1], sh[2])
            font:SetShadowColor(0, 0, 0, shadow)
        end
    end
end

local baseApply = T.Apply
function T.Apply()
    baseApply()
    pcall(DressFonts)
end

-- Windows, side panels and popups: DaylightUI's shell under them, FLBiS's own
-- flat backdrop cleared (after its opacity painter, on every T.Apply).
local baseWindow = W.Window
function W.Window(f, popup)
    baseWindow(f, popup)
    if not active or T.Classic() then return end
    local api = DUI()
    if not api then return end
    local opts = popup and { bgAlpha = 0.97 } or { window = true }
    local ok, shell = pcall(api.Skin, f, opts)
    if not (ok and shell) then return end
    T.Track(function()
        f:SetBackdropColor(0, 0, 0, 0)
        f:SetBackdropBorderColor(0, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    -- (laid out again when FLBiS resizes the window: the panels slide open)
    f:HookScript("OnSizeChanged", function(self)
        local a = DUI()
        if a then pcall(a.Skin, self, opts) end
    end)
end

local loader = CreateFrame("Frame")
loader:RegisterEvent("ADDON_LOADED")
loader:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_LOGIN")
loader:SetScript("OnEvent", function(self, event, name)
    if event == "PLAYER_LOGIN" then
        -- (again once every addon's settings are in: DaylightUI's accent and tint)
        self:UnregisterEvent("PLAYER_LOGIN")
        if active then pcall(Paint) end
        return
    end
    if name ~= addonName then return end
    self:UnregisterEvent("ADDON_LOADED")
    -- (the saved theme, as T.Theme fixes it for the session; a widget made
    -- after this sees the Daylight palette)
    local db = rawget(_G, "ForeverLevelingBiSDB")
    local theme = type(db) == "table" and type(db.display) == "table" and db.display.theme
    local api = DUI()
    active = theme == KEY and api ~= nil
    if not active then return end
    pcall(Paint)
    -- Repaint when DaylightUI's look changes (accent, tint, opacity). Colors a
    -- widget set once when made catch up on the next /reload.
    if type(api.On) == "function" then
        api.On("StyleChanged", function()
            pcall(Paint)
            T.Apply()
        end, OWNER)
    end
end)
